cultural.vision_reason: Studio portrait of three Cheyenne men (White Antelope, High Toe, Little Chief) in traditional dress—decorated shirts, leggings, feathers, warbonnet, and ornaments—clearly documenting Cheyenne attire and appearance.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); album
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) from an album; studio portrait of White Antelope a Cheyenne man, High Toe a Cheyenne chief, and Little Chief a Cheyenne chief, all seated; White Antelope is wearing a decorated shirt, decorated leggings, a peace medal, ear ornaments, and a feather in his hair, his hair is in two bunches wrapped in cloth; High Toe is wearing a decorated fringed shirt, leggings, a peace medal, an eagle feather in his hair and abalone shell ear ornaments, his hair is in two bunches wrapped in fur; Little Chief is wearing a decorated fringed shirt, decorated leggings, a trailer warbonnet, a shell choker and a peace medal, he is holding a pipe and a pipe bag; Washington D.C., United States of America 
Albumen print
